summary_claims.claim: Switzerland is to ratify the Council of Europe AI Convention, which will apply primarily to state actors; legislative changes as sector-specific as possible.
FDJP to draft a bill for consultation by the end of 2026; DETEC to prepare a plan for non-binding measures by the end of 2026.

note: The English admin.ch release (published 12 Feb 2025) and the German release (title only, from the 11 Oct copy) match the record; the original_title quote comes from the stored German page. BJ's page shows the consultation bill is still being prepared; a search found no opening of a consultation. Status unchanged.
